run_id: copy the immutable run_id printed by start-run
mechanism: At least 50 characters: the precise mechanism this candidate implements.
hypothesis: At least 50 characters: a directional, metric-linked, falsifiable prediction.
change_summary: At least 40 characters: exact changes from the relevant prior candidate.
falsifier: At least 30 characters: the observed outcome that rejects this idea.
why_now: At least 40 characters: why current evidence makes this the next best use of an iteration.
